title: Portraits Through Time
description: Faces that have held our gaze across the centuries.
source: Art Institute of Chicago, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Portrait of an Artist
items.description_narrative: A man in a wide-brimmed black hat looks over his shoulder with a faint, knowing smile, one arm akimbo. Loose, confident brushwork in the white collar and dark coat gives the portrait an easy, spontaneous energy.
items.tags: dutch golden age, loose brushwork, wide-brimmed hat, informal portrait

items.title: The Captive Slave (Ira Aldridge)
items.description_narrative: A man in a torn red garment sits with his wrists shackled together, chains coiled beside him. He gazes upward, his expression caught between sorrow and resolve, rendered against a plain, dark background that leaves nothing to soften the scene.
items.tags: manacles, red garment, dramatic lighting, emotive gaze, 19th century portraiture

items.title: Portrait of a Man with Gray Hair
items.description_narrative: A man with soft grey hair and a ruddy complexion emerges from deep shadow, his dark coat nearly merging with the background. Loose, confident brushwork picks out the folds of his white cravat and the quiet intensity of his gaze.
items.tags: scottish portraiture, grey hair, dark palette, georgian era

items.title: Édouard Manet
items.description_narrative: Edouard Manet is shown in three-quarter profile wearing a tall black top hat, a gloved hand resting on his walking cane. His full reddish beard and mustache are carefully groomed, painted in warm, muted browns against a plain backdrop.
items.tags: top hat, beard, realism, muted palette, portrait

items.title: Madame de Pastoret and Her Son
items.description_narrative: A woman in a flowing white dress sits beside a wicker cradle, winding a length of cloth in her hands while a sleeping infant rests inside. Her softly curled hair and calm, direct gaze anchor the otherwise plain, warmly lit room.
items.tags: mother and infant, cradle, white dress, neoclassicism, french portraiture

items.title: Old Man with a Gold Chain
items.description_narrative: An old man in a dark cloak and plumed velvet cap turns slightly toward the light, a heavy gold chain and medallion crossing his chest over a steel gorget. Deep shadow surrounds his weathered, deeply lined face.
items.tags: dutch golden age, gold chain, gorget, plumed cap, chiaroscuro

items.title: Young Woman at an Open Half-Door
items.description_narrative: A young woman leans on a wooden half-door, her red-beaded necklace and lace collar catching the light against her plain brown dress. Her gaze drifts downward, hands resting loosely on the worn wooden ledge in front of her.
items.tags: half-door, genre scene, informal portrait, dutch golden age
items.credit_line: Art Institute of Chicago, online collection

items.title: The Child's Bath
items.description_narrative: A woman bathes a young child's feet in a large basin, cradling the child securely against her striped robe. The high, tilted viewpoint and bold pattern of the rug and wallpaper give the tender, everyday moment an unusually flattened, graphic quality.
items.tags: mother and child, bath time, bold pattern, domestic scene, impressionism

items.title: Interrupted Reading
items.medium: Oil on canvas, mounted on board
items.description_narrative: A woman pauses over an open book, her head propped on one hand as she looks out with a faint, thoughtful smile. A beaded headband and coral necklace stand out against her simple white blouse and loosely painted brown skirt.
items.tags: barbizon school, reading, contemplative, headband, informal portrait

items.title: Madame François Buron
items.description_narrative: A woman in an elaborately ruffled and striped gown looks up from two open books, one hand still raised to her powdered hair. A black ribbon choker and playful half-smile give the portrait a lively, informal feel.
items.tags: 18th century, ruffled gown, powdered hair, books, informal portrait

items.title: Portrait of a Man with a Pink
items.description_narrative: A man in a black cap and dark tunic holds a small white flower between two fingers, his gaze directed just past the viewer. Soft light models his weathered face against a plain blue background.
items.tags: early netherlandish, flower symbolism, portrait, blue background

items.title: Amédée-David, the Comte de Pastoret
items.description_narrative: Amedee-David de Pastoret stands with one hand resting on the hilt of his sword and the other tucked into his black jacket, a Legion of Honour medal pinned at his throat. His tousled curls and steady gaze contrast with the crisp, sculptural precision of his tailored clothes.
items.tags: neoclassicism, sword, legion of honour, formal portrait, tailored dress

items.title: Merahi metua no Tehamana (Tehamana Has Many Parents or The Ancestors of Tehamana)
items.description_narrative: A young woman in a blue-and-white striped dress holds a woven fan close to her body, a red flower tucked behind her ear. Golden fruit rests in the corner beside her, while carved figures and rows of undeciphered script fill the wall behind her.
items.tags: tahiti, striped dress, fan, symbolism, post-impressionism

items.title: Francesco de' Medici
items.description_narrative: A young man in an ornately embroidered red doublet stands at a table, a small gold medallion held between his fingers. His dark, close-cropped hair and steady gaze are set against an almost black background, with only a glimpse of an ornate chair visible behind him.
items.tags: mannerism, medici, red doublet, gold medallion, italian renaissance

items.title: Beggar with Oysters (Philosopher)
items.description_narrative: A bearded man wrapped in a heavy blue cloak and wearing a wide dark green hat stands against a bare, shadowy ground. A small scatter of oyster shells lies at his feet, the only object breaking the plain expanse of floor.
items.tags: realism, beggar, still life detail, dark palette, genre portrait

items.title: Polynesian Woman with Children
items.description_narrative: A seated woman holds a young child on her lap while an older girl beside her cradles a small white dog. Painted in cool blues and greens, the three figures fill the canvas with quiet, unhurried closeness.
items.tags: tahiti, mother and children, cool palette, post-impressionism, family group

items.title: Portrait of General José Manuel Romero
items.agent_name: Francisco José de Goya y Lucientes
items.description_narrative: A man in a black uniform heavily embroidered with gold stands against total darkness, a wide red sash crossing his chest and medals pinned at his shoulder. Delicate lace cuffs and a red medal ribbon add small notes of color to the otherwise somber palette.
items.tags: gold embroidery, red sash, military portrait, dark background, spanish romanticism

items.title: Portrait of Constance Pipelet
items.description_narrative: A young woman with curled auburn hair tied in a red ribbon sits in a plain white dress cinched with a blue sash. Her calm, direct gaze and softly lit skin stand out against a hazy blue sky and distant hills.
items.tags: neoclassicism, red ribbon, white dress, outdoor backdrop, french portraiture

items.title: Mrs. Potter Palmer
items.description_narrative: A woman in a shimmering white gown and tiara stands beside a sunlit window, a fan held loosely in one gloved hand. Loose, bravura brushwork captures the sheen of her satin dress against the dim room behind her.
items.tags: society portrait, white gown, tiara, bravura brushwork, gilded age

items.title: John Thomlinson and His Family
items.description_narrative: A family of five gathers in an elegantly furnished parlor: a seated gentleman near his writing table, two women in pale gowns, and a young boy reaching to take the hand of a woman in blue. A patterned carpet, marble fireplace, and terrestrial globe furnish the room around them.
items.tags: conversation piece, family group, georgian interior, 18th century, globe

items.title: Portrait of a Noblewoman Dressed in Mourning
items.description_narrative: A woman in heavy black mourning dress stands beside a small crucifix on a draped table, one hand resting on her chest and the other holding a folded cloth. A dark curtain and plain wall frame her still, composed figure.
items.tags: mourning dress, italian baroque, crucifix, formal portrait

items.title: Helena Tromper Du Bois
items.description_narrative: Helena Tromper is shown half-length in black satin, an elaborate lace collar spilling over her shoulders and lace cuffs framing her folded hands. Small gold earrings and a fine necklace catch the light against the warm brown backdrop.
items.tags: flemish baroque, lace collar, black satin, half-length portrait, formal dress

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: Frederic Bazille turns to look over his shoulder, a paint-laden palette held against his hip and a fine brush in hand. His dark waistcoat and crisp white shirtsleeves stand out sharply against the plain, shadowed studio background.
items.tags: self-portrait, early impressionism, palette and brush, studio setting

items.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Man at a Casement
items.description_narrative: A woman in profile wears an elaborately jeweled headdress and gold-buttoned red gown, her hands folded before her. Through a window behind her, a man leans in from an adjoining room, his hand raised, framed by a view of a distant landscape.
items.tags: casement window, jeweled headdress, profile portrait, early renaissance, tempera
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Portrait of Doge Leonardo Loredan
items.description_narrative: A man wears an ornate horned cap and a damask robe patterned with gold foliage, buttoned with a row of carved toggles. His composed, weathered face is set firmly against a flat blue background, the paint built up in fine, controlled detail.
items.tags: doge's cap, damask robe, formal portrait, blue background, venetian renaissance

items.title: Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione
items.description_narrative: Seen here in a muted grayscale reproduction, a bearded man in a soft, voluminous cap looks out with steady, deep-set eyes. A pleated white collar spills over his dark cloak, the only sharp passage of light in an otherwise softly modeled portrait.
items.tags: renaissance portrait, grayscale reproduction, pleated collar, soft modeling

items.title: The Ambassadors
items.description_narrative: Two richly dressed men stand at either side of a table piled with globes, a lute, and instruments for reckoning time and the stars, all set against a heavy green damask curtain. Across the patterned floor at their feet stretches a strange, elongated smear of grey that cuts diagonally through the scene.
items.tags: double portrait, still life objects, damask curtain, globes, northern renaissance

items.title: Portrait of Henry VIII
items.description_narrative: Henry VIII stands in a gold brocade robe trimmed with dark fur, a heavy jeweled chain crossing his chest over a red-and-gold doublet. Inscriptions naming his age flank his head against a deep blue background, his bearded face set in a level, unflinching stare.
items.tags: tudor portraiture, gold brocade, jeweled chain, blue background

items.title: Portrait of a Man in a Red Turban
items.description_narrative: A man's face emerges from near-total darkness, lit sharply to reveal every crease and stubbled hair. A voluminous red turban, wound in thick folds, dominates the composition above his steady, appraising gaze.
items.tags: red turban, self-portrait, chiaroscuro, northern renaissance
items.credit_line: EXTRACTED (AND COMPRESSED) FROM AN OLD VERSION OF THIS FILE File:Portrait of a Man by Jan van Eyck.jpg.

items.title: The Arnolfini Portrait
items.description_narrative: A couple stand hand in hand in a richly furnished chamber, a small dog at their feet and a round mirror reflecting the room behind them. The woman's voluminous green gown and the man's fur-trimmed robe are rendered in exacting, almost microscopic detail, down to the brass chandelier overhead.
items.tags: double portrait, domestic interior, mirror, fur trim, northern renaissance
items.credit_line: Web site of National Gallery, London

items.title: Infanta Margarita Teresa in a Blue Dress
items.description_narrative: A young girl in an enormous blue and silver gown stands beside a dark fur muff, her long blonde hair loose beneath a small dark bow. Behind her, a table holds carved lion figurines and a mirror, hinting at the formality of a royal household.
items.tags: infanta, blue gown, baroque, spanish court, royal portrait

items.title: Charles I at the Hunt
items.cultural_context: Flemish Baroque at the English court
items.description_narrative: A man in a white satin doublet and red breeches stands casually beside a grey horse beneath a spreading tree, cane in hand and hat tilted back. Behind him, two attendants and the horse's handler wait, the relaxed pose set against a soft, sunlit sky.
items.tags: equestrian scene, hunting dress, outdoor portrait, flemish baroque

items.title: Portrait of Pope Innocent X
items.description_narrative: Pope Innocent X sits in a gilded chair, his red silk mozzetta and cape rendered in shifting layers of crimson against a deep red curtain. His penetrating gaze and slightly parted lips give the portrait a startling, almost confrontational immediacy.
items.tags: baroque, papal portrait, red vestments, gilded chair, spanish baroque

items.title: Portrait of Pope Julius II
items.description_narrative: Pope Julius II sits deep in thought, his long white beard spilling over a heavy red velvet cape trimmed in white fur. His ringed fingers grip a cloth in his lap, set against a plain green background that leaves the softly modeled figure fully in focus.
items.tags: high renaissance, papal portrait, white beard, velvet cape, green background

items.title: Self-Portrait in a Straw Hat
items.description_narrative: This is a later version of the artist's self-portrait with a palette: she looks out from beneath a wide straw hat trimmed with flowers and a curling feather, palette and brushes in hand. Soft clouds and blue sky fill the background behind her pink-and-black dress.
items.tags: self-portrait, straw hat, artist at work, later version, rococo
items.credit_line: Selected work 27 from Self Portrait: Renaissance to Contemporary (Anthony Bond, Joanna Woodall, ISBN 978-1855143579).

items.title: Alexander Grant
items.description_narrative: A young man in a richly gold-embroidered red coat and waistcoat holds a small red book in one hand, his hat tucked beneath the other arm. Behind him, a stone balustrade opens onto a distant landscape of trees and hills.
items.tags: red coat, gold embroidery, 18th century, balustrade, formal portrait

items.title: Lucrezia di Lippo di Iacopo Guidi
items.description_narrative: A woman's profile is set within a circular medallion bordered by a dark red panel, her white headscarf and simple blue-grey dress rendered with quiet restraint. A thin cord necklace is just visible at her throat.
items.tags: tondo, profile portrait, renaissance, medallion format, restrained palette

items.title: Portrait of Dr. William McNeill Whistler
items.description_narrative: A bearded man in a wide-brimmed dark hat and loose white coat is rendered in soft, blended brushwork against a warm brown ground. A black cravat is the only sharp accent in an otherwise muted, almost monochrome study.
items.tags: tonalism, soft brushwork, monochrome study, bearded sitter

items.title: Arrangement in Flesh Color and Brown: Portrait of Arthur Jerome Eddy
items.description_narrative: Arthur Jerome Eddy stands full-length in a dark coat against a nearly bare brown ground, his figure emerging softly from the muted tones around him. He holds his hat in one gloved hand, the whole portrait built from close, tonal harmonies rather than sharp contrast.
items.tags: tonalism, full-length portrait, muted palette, brown harmony

items.title: Mrs. John Nicholson (Hannah Duncan) and John Nicholson, Jr.
items.description_narrative: A woman with dark curled hair holds a young child dressed in white on her lap, the child clutching a sprig of flowers. The child's wide-brimmed blue hat with a black plume adds a playful note to the otherwise composed portrait, framed by a distant autumn landscape.
items.tags: mother and child, american portraiture, plumed hat, autumn landscape, 18th century

items.title: James Vibert, Sculptor
items.description_narrative: A man with a full, wiry red beard and piercing pale eyes looks out against a flat yellow-green background. His open dark jacket reveals a loosely rendered white shirt, the simplified forms and bold color giving the portrait a striking, graphic directness.
items.tags: symbolism, red beard, flat background, graphic style, early 20th century

items.title: James William Wallack
items.description_narrative: James William Wallack is shown from the shoulders up, dark curly hair framing a faintly amused expression. His high white collar and loosely knotted cravat stand out against a plain, dark brown background.
items.tags: 19th century portraiture, actor, high collar, dark background

items.title: Isabella Wolff
items.description_narrative: A woman in a flowing white gown and gold-trimmed turban leans over a large open book resting on a red-draped table. A pink rose is tucked at her waist, and a sculpture is glimpsed in the shadows behind her.
items.tags: romanticism, turban, illuminated book, rose, british portraiture

items.title: Dr. Joseph Klapp
items.description_narrative: A seated man rests his chin thoughtfully on one hand, a red leather-bound volume propped nearby. His dark coat and the plain, warmly lit background focus attention entirely on his contemplative expression.
items.tags: american portraiture, seated pose, contemplative, book, early 19th century

items.title: Mrs. Klapp (Anna Milnor)
items.description_narrative: A woman in a high-necked white dress with a ruffled collar sits with her hands folded, a pale shawl draped over one shoulder. Loose curls frame her face, painted with soft, warm lighting against a plain brown backdrop.
items.tags: american portraiture, ruffled collar, soft lighting, early 19th century

items.title: Sarah Dupont
items.description_narrative: A woman in an elaborately ruffled lace bonnet looks out with a faint, direct gaze, a large bow tied beneath her chin. Loose, feathery brushstrokes render her greying curls and the soft lace trim against a plain dark background.
items.tags: british portraiture, lace bonnet, feathery brushwork, dark background

items.title: Riter Fitzgerald
items.description_narrative: A man in a dark suit reclines in a tasseled armchair, one leg crossed and a book open on his lap. Shelves of leather-bound volumes fill the shadowed room behind him, with more books stacked loosely on the patterned rug.
items.tags: american realism, library setting, reclining pose, books, dark interior

items.title: Portrait of Mary Adeline Williams
items.description_narrative: A woman in a dark, pleated blouse and high lace collar looks out with a level, unadorned gaze. Painted almost entirely in browns and blacks, the portrait leaves her face as the sole point of light in the composition.
items.tags: american realism, plain palette, lace collar, direct gaze

items.title: Rêverie (Portrait of Gabrielle Borreau)
items.medium: Oil on paper, mounted on canvas
items.description_narrative: A young woman with loose, flowing brown hair tucks a strand behind her ear, gazing off to the side with a faint smile. A thin cross necklace catches the light at her throat, set against a hazy sunset sky and distant water.
items.tags: realism, flowing hair, sunset backdrop, pensive gaze, informal portrait
items.credit_line: Art Institute of Chicago, online collection

items.title: Mère Grégoire
items.description_narrative: A woman in a black dress and lace collar leans on a marble-topped table, a small vase of flowers beside her. She holds something delicate between her fingers, her profile turned upward with a faint, knowing smile.
items.tags: realism, lace collar, marble table, flowers, profile
